svg.title: Building an action dependency graph
svg.desc: Three AGVs on a six-cell map with timed plans; the ADG has a Type 1 chain per AGV and two Type 2 edges from the location rule. Inset: three AGVs rotating at the same time give a cycle.

g.text: Type 1: consecutive actions of the same AGV, a[i,k] -> a[i,k+1]. Type 2:

g.text: for AGVs i != j, an edge a[i,k] -> a[j,l] when s(i,k) = g(j,l) and t(i,k) <= t(j,l):

g.text: a[i,k] is the k-th action of AGV i (a^i_k in the text); @t is its planned start time. Construction as in Algorithm 1 of Hönig et al., RA-L 2019.

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: Each action of each AGV is a vertex. Type 1 edges keep each AGV's own order; Type 2 edges say who must clear a location before someone else enters it. The ADG keeps the plan's order and forgets its exact times.
